Specification: This specification models Safra's distributed termination detection algorithm on a ring, as described in EWD 998. Nodes maintain activity status, colors, local message counters, pending in-flight messages, and a circulating token whose position, accumulated counter, and color are used to detect global termination. The spec includes safety properties relating token-based detection to actual system termination, an inductive invariant for the algorithm, a liveness property stating that termination is eventually detected, and TLC-specific state and action constraints to bound checking and collect runtime statistics.
IfThenElse:
IF token.pos = N-1 
                THEN token.q = 0 
                ELSE token.q = Reduce(sum, counter, (token.pos+1), N-1, 0)
IF \E i \in Nodes: PassToken(i) THEN 1 ELSE 0
FunctionConstructor: [ n \in Nodes |-> IF ~active[n] /\ active'[n] THEN 1 ELSE 0 ]
[ n \in Nodes |-> o[n] + IF ~v[n] /\ v'[n] THEN 1 ELSE 0 ]
FunctionOverride:
[token EXCEPT !.pos = @ - 1,
                            !.q = @ + counter[i],
                            !.color = IF color[i] = "black" THEN "black" ELSE @]
RecordConstructor:
[
        active |-> active,
        pending |-> pending,
        color |-> color,
        counter |-> counter,
        token |-> token,

        TokenInits  |-> TLCGetAndSet(0, +, IF InitiateProbe THEN 1 ELSE 0, 0),
        
        TokenPasses |-> TLCGetAndSet(1, +, IF \E i \in Nodes: PassToken(i) THEN 1 ELSE 0, 0),

        Activations |-> TLCGetAndSet(2, 
                            LAMBDA o, v: Pairwise(o, v, +), 
                                        [ n \in Nodes |-> IF ~active[n] /\ active'[n] THEN 1 ELSE 0 ],
                            [ n \in Nodes |-> 0 ]),
                            
        Activations2|-> TLCGetAndSet(3, 
                            LAMBDA o, v: [ n \in Nodes |-> o[n] + IF ~v[n] /\ v'[n] THEN 1 ELSE 0 ], 
                                        active,
                            [ n \in Nodes |-> 0 ]),

        Actives     |-> TLCGetAndSet(4, \cup, {active}, {active}),
        
        SumQ        |-> TLCGetAndSet(5, +, token.q, 0),
        SumQP       |-> TLCGetAndSet(6, +, token.q', 0)
    ]
StateConstraint:
StateConstraint ==
  /\ \A i \in Nodes : counter[i] <= 3 /\ pending[i] <= 3
  /\ token.q <= 3
ActionConstraint:
ActionConstraint ==
    token \in Token \* Some non-constant expression that would otherwise optimized out.
